findings.title: Defer app imports until an app is selected
findings.body: Each `import()` is executed while this object is constructed, so merely importing `@calcom/app-store` starts loading every integration module. Awaiting only the selected entry later does not prevent the other integrations and their dependencies from loading. This defeats on-demand loading and retains the startup and memory cost of loading all apps; store loader functions instead and invoke only the selected one.

findings.title: Await the calendar cancellation callbacks
findings.body: This callback now awaits the dynamic calendar import, but `forEach` discards the callback promise. The reschedule mutation can therefore continue to send emails and webhooks, and return, before the calendar deletion has started; a failed import also becomes an unhandled rejection. Await the callbacks (for example, with `Promise.all` over `map`) so cancellation completes or its failure is handled before reporting success.

findings.title: Await the calendar cancellation callbacks
findings.body: This callback now awaits the dynamic calendar import, but `forEach` discards the callback promise. `Reschedule` can send the reschedule email and return success before calendar deletion has started, and failures inside the async callback are not caught by the surrounding `try/catch`. Await the callbacks and handle their failures before reporting success.
